Many of the Chugs are wearing strange bee-like costumes" (2055535663), "Chugzy has suggested I follow one of the Bixie Workers to the source." (1040840897), helps in the fights of Elf Ex Machina and Countering the Cavalry (client "With the aid of Chugzy", 1236821161; wiki quotes). Client line: "I'll handle the obelisk!
